text: @gitdek's watchers run Codex at high, not ultra, from 2026-10-30, by his call. Codex usage was down to about a quarter of his plan's limit with no resets left, and #227 alone had taken 24 runs. The loop guard's fallback runs at medium, below the new effort. ultra stays -codex-effort's default, and he can go back to it, or down to medium, by changing the watchers' arguments. Issues off the ask3d path (#261, #263, #269, #298) are closed until there's usage for them, and reopening one resumes it.
